discussion_comments.comment_body: Restored h-full min-h-0 on the dashboard <main> in clientLayout.tsx. The removal was incidental to the licensing commit (the sibling MinimalShell still had it), and dropping it would collapse full-height child panels that rely on flex-1/h-full. Both <main> elements now carry flex h-full min-h-0 flex-col overflow-y-hidden, so full-height flex layouts fill the viewport again.
We can put this function in `ui/lib/utils/numbers.ts`.

Fixed — separated display and tooltip formatting. Display values remain rounded (`toFixed(2)`, `toFixed(4)`), while tooltip values now use full precision from the raw stat data (e.g., `stats.success_rate` instead of `stats.success_rate.toFixed(2)`). `totalRequests` and `totalTokens` use `toLocaleString()` for both since they're integers.
